name: Continue roleplays on monster births
description: Users asked the AI to continue role-playing scenarios in video game-inspired fictional settings where a player character assists non-human creatures, mobs, or monsters giving birth to offspring. The requests typically involved narrating the delivery process, caring for newborns, or developing the narrative around the reproductive events of these non-human entities.
